facts.text: WheelLeggedEnv is the concrete Genesis environment class of the repository
The environment imports genesis as gs
The constructor takes num_envs, the env, observation, reward, command, curriculum, domain randomization and terrain configurations, robot_morphs, show_viewer, num_view, device and train_mode
The control period is 0.01 s, 100 Hz
The Genesis scene uses the control period and five physics substeps
The training configuration sets num_actions to 8
The training configuration lists the left and right hip, thigh, calf and wheel joints
The training configuration sets num_obs to 286, num_slice_obs to 28 and history_length to 9
The training configuration sets num_commands to 6
The observation row concatenates the history buffer, the current slice and the scaled commands
step clips every action to the configured clip_actions range
The training configuration sets clip_actions to 100.0
step advances the Genesis scene once with scene.step()
step returns the observation, None for the privileged observation, the reward buffer, the reset flag buffer and the extras
reset sets reset_buf, calls reset_idx for every environment and returns the existing obs_buf and None
reset_idx resets the DOF and base state and the episode buffers but does not recompute the observation buffers
The episode timeout is marked in extras['time_outs'] for every environment whose episode_length_buf exceeds max_episode_length
check_termination sets reset_buf from the episode length, the roll and pitch limits and contact with the listed links
When train_mode is true, step calls reset_idx for every environment whose reset_buf is set before it computes the reward and observation
The training configuration sets episode_length_s to 20.0
The training script initializes Genesis with the GPU backend
The training script defaults num_envs to 8192
The training configuration carries a runner seed of 1
The install dependencies are genesis-world, tensorboard, pygame, torch and the in-tree rsl-rl
The README states that the repository is reinforcement learning of wheel-legged robots based on Genesis and that sim2sim in MuJoCo is supported
The README says Genesis 0.2.1 cannot be installed from pip and must be a local installation of the main branch because of an API update

determinism.notes: WheelLeggedEnv has no seed method; the reset action seeds Python random, NumPy and Torch with its seed input (default 0) before calling the native reset.  The fake draws its initial joint positions from Python random, so the same seed repeats a reset; it was never compared with the upstream simulator

gaps: the fake backend is a pure Python analytic stand-in: it models the 8-value action, the 10 ms tick, the 286-value observation layout, a one-step action latency and the episode length, but no Genesis engine, rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, terrain, sensors, reward terms or domain randomization, and it was never compared with the upstream environment

the upstream environment needs Genesis from the main branch, PyTorch, OpenCV, pygame and the repository's MJCF/URDF/terrain assets (README.md:11-13, pyproject.toml:8-14); it was not installed or run where the gate ran

WheelLeggedEnv.reset sets reset_buf and calls reset_idx, then returns the existing obs_buf (locomotion/wheel_legged_env.py:602-605); reset_idx does not recompute the observation buffers, so the upstream reset observation can be stale.  The fake returns a fresh initial observation, which differs from that native path

when train_mode is true the upstream step auto-resets the environments whose reset_buf is set (locomotion/wheel_legged_env.py:477); the driver reports the terminal flags and requires an explicit cap.world.reset.v1 before the next step instead of exposing the auto-reset

the real environment is vectorized over num_envs (the training script defaults to 8192, locomotion/wheel_legged_train.py:277); the driver models one instance and returns its first observation row, so num_envs above 1 is not exposed

only the default training configuration of locomotion/wheel_legged_train.py get_cfgs is modelled (8 actions, 286 observations, clip_actions 100.0, 20 s episodes and train_mode true); another env_cfg changes the action clip and the observation layout
the fake reward, command vector, observation history and wheel and joint kinematics are placeholder test data, not the reward terms of locomotion/wheel_legged_env.py:700-940
snapshot and restore are not offered: WheelLeggedEnv exposes no get_state/set_state
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against one

operator_required.reason: The deployment must supply both action bounds for its env_cfg; the training configuration shows clip_actions=100.0 but no single cited span states the complete signed numeric interval. The example overlay is for fake checks only.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation and tick stay readable
